app.yaml `css:` chooses what the framework's HTML document loads around a server-rendered page. `tailwind` (the default): Tailwind and Alpine. `themed`: the same plus the colour variables of the `theme:` preset (`--background`, `--primary`, `--border` and the rest), which the utility classes `bg-background`, `text-primary` and `border-border` read. `none`: neither, for pages that bring their own CSS; HTMX, the CSRF meta tag and head.html still load. Any other `css:` value loads what `tailwind` loads.

`theme:` names the colour preset of `css: themed` pages: `zinc` (the default), `slate`, `stone`, `gray`, `neutral`, `red`, `rose`, `orange`, `green`, `blue`, `yellow` or `violet`. `mode:` is `dark` (the default) or `light`. Each takes one value in lower case. A `theme:` or `mode:` value outside these is accepted and selects nothing, and a `theme:`, `mode:` or `css:` written as a list or a mapping is not read; a write of app.yaml and `benmore check` warn about an unknown `theme:`, `mode:` or `css:` value and about the unread ones, and name the nearest value.
`css:` does nothing for files under static/: each is served as written and loads what its own <head> names (api({at:'frontend'}) styling).

`nav:` draws no navigation: write the nav in a layout or a partial. `nav.theme` is another spelling of `theme:` and counts only while `theme:` is absent; `nav.brand` and `nav.font` set the accent colour and the font of the /_admin panel and nothing else. `radius:` and `shadow:` change nothing: the corner radius of these pages is the CSS variable `--radius`, which a `theme.css` file at the app root can set (`:root { --radius: 0.75rem; }`). The write gate and `benmore check` warn about `nav.theme`, any other `nav` key but those two, `radius:` and `shadow:` (api({at:'frontend'}) site_identity).
